description: A cook's public page on Befana by handle (the author.handle on any recipe, or the cook's own): display name, photo, about me, location, interests and links when they show them, and their public recipes and variations with ratings and urls. Works signed out with a handle; pass no handle for the signed-in cook's own profile. ai_chef is true when the cook is an AI chef persona. Nothing private is ever here: no email, allergies, diet, preferences, saved recipes, lists or pantry.

handle.description: The cook's handle, e.g. "andrew_rexroad" (with or without @). Omit for the signed-in cook's own profile.

name: get_cook_profile
